title: Systemic Transformation State & Integration Core

satisfied: APW/D26 Campaign Activity and Project/Time contract surfaces available
required World/Environment/Organization owner contract surfaces available
selection_basis.reduced_strict_order: MSWI-01 → MSWI-03 → MSWI-04 → MSWI-06 → MSWI-07 → MSWI-14 → MSWI-18

objective: Implement the reduced MSWI opening seam: reusable SystemicTransformationProfileDefinition and read-only SystemicTransformationProjection contracts, exact owner/version references, threshold and milestone attribution, integration-registry bindings, deterministic validation and stale-state handling, migration/version compatibility, and inspectable semantic API/UI projections without copying mutable World, Environment, Organization or other owner-domain canonical state.
acceptance: SystemicTransformationProfileDefinition is reusable, versioned and contains only references to owner-backed transformation dimensions, route/profile metadata and policy; it does not copy mutable canonical owner state.

SystemicTransformationProjection is read-only, binds exact owner versions, exposes supplied qualitative/quantitative bands without invention, and becomes explicitly stale when required owner versions change.
Transformation thresholds and milestones remain attributable to exact profile/rule/source versions and unresolved dimensions remain unresolved rather than inferred.
Integration registry bindings identify exact owner/domain interfaces and reject missing, stale or incompatible owner references deterministically.
Profile/projection schema migration updates integration representation only and never silently mutates canonical Campaign/world/owner state or reinterprets historical receipts.
Permission filtering precedes participant-facing transformation projection, explanation, counts, search, AI context and export.
Inspectable transformation API/UI exposes accessible textual/semantic state and provenance without requiring color, animation, maps, audio, AI or paid/cloud services.
MSLR typed Events/observations/deltas can bind into the transformation integration seam without MSWI taking spatial-law ownership.
Provider-off deterministic tests prove canonical/projection separation, stale-version behavior, unresolved data handling and owner-boundary preservation.
boundaries: MSLR-18 and all upstream completed programs remain sealed.
World, Environment, Reality/Branch, Organization and other source domains retain canonical mutable state authority.
GPR/Action/Event retain generic execution and immutable Event history; MSWI begins only from accepted owner Events/changes or explicit previews.
MSWI-01 creates integration definitions and read-only projections only; consequence routing/commit runtime remains unauthorized until MSWI-03.
MCS/MAS/MCCS/MSAS remain presentation/authoring owners; visible presentation is not canonical world mutation.
No hidden route, dimension or owner-state existence may leak through projection counts, search, diagnostics, AI context or export.
Optional AI remains advisory and no paid/cloud provider is required for blocking workflows.
MSWI-03 and later MSWI tranches remain unauthorized until canonical MSWI-01 closeout.
next_action: Establish causal RED for MSWI-01 through the public systemic-transformation profile/projection seam, then implement only the bounded schema, validation, owner-binding, stale-state, migration and inspectable projection behavior required by the reduced family contract.

last_material_progress.evidence: Owner Continue explicitly authorized cross-family gpr slot reuse and governed start of MSWI-01 from terminal completed_verified MSLR-18.
